description: This file defines the 'FileInfo' struct and related functions for managing file metadata within the Mattermost project, including file properties, validation, and access control.

classes.name: FileInfo
classes.description: Represents metadata about a file, including identifiers, paths, size, MIME type, and preview information.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of file info fields suitable for auditing.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Initializes or updates fields before saving, such as ID, timestamps, and remote ID.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the file info fields, returning an error if invalid.

methods.name: IsImage
methods.description: Checks if the file is an image based on MIME type.

methods.name: IsSvg
methods.description: Checks if the file is an SVG image.

methods.name: NewInfo
methods.description: Creates a new FileInfo instance with inferred MIME type and extension from filename.

methods.name: GetEtagForFileInfos
methods.description: Generates an ETag string based on a list of FileInfo objects.

methods.name: MakeContentInaccessible
methods.description: Marks the file info as archived and clears sensitive content and paths.
